A Trump, Putin, and Xi Meeting Won’t Be Yalta 2.0. But It Still Matters

There, on the Black Sea’s pebbled shore, the Soviet Union, Great Britain, and the U.S. held negotiations that would eventually split the planet into competing spheres of influence.
